title: Tightening sanctions on Russia is 'the way to end this war,' says David Kramer
summary: With US intelligence sharing with Ukraine restored, Geoff Bennett asks former State Department official David Kramer whether the thaw between Washington and Kyiv will last. Kramer describes a repeated cycle of clashes and reconciliations since early 2025 and argues that Moscow is exploiting the instability. He says more economic pressure, including sanctions on Russia's shadow fleet and banks, is the most realistic way to end the war.
focus: Shadow David Kramer's closing answer on why tighter sanctions are the way forward: a structured, persuasive argument with clear signposting that suits a recommendation slide or client pitch.
